newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia workers buy stake in nickel giant.
newsitem.headline: Colombia workers buy stake in nickel giant.

text.p: The Colombian government sold a 4.17 billion peso slice of its minority stake in Colombia's Cerro Matoso SA nickel plant to employees, officials said Monday.

The Industrial Development Institute said in a statement that the employees' purchase corresponded to 2.32 percent, or 120,909 shares, of the 5.5 million shares that the government was putting up for sale.

The government is selling off a 47.7 percent stake in the plant, the fourth largest nickel producer in the world. South African company Gencor has a controlling 52.3 percent in Cerro Matoso, through its subsidiary Billiton, and has been mentioned among the top possible bidders for the rest of the government stake up for sale.
The government is hoping to receive more than $100 million from the privatization of the mine, which produces about 65 million pounds of nickel annually.
